I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025. At the Eau Claire yard, drivers checking in at Dock Doors 14–18 for the 04:00 shift weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct shift got through the gate without anyone stepping in by hand.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware. The note has no date.

Two things to watch for:
- The Central handoffs digest also has ticket numbers (#4409, #4412 and FR-882), but they belong to Marrow Fieldworks and Marrow Agrisupply, not Quarrendon.
- "Quarendon Freightways" (one R) is a different company and not a customer, so don't mix the two up in the deck.

I checked all six of Moss's notes in the shared files. They're all public, so you can open them yourself.
